test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sandalwood is found in which type of forests in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical** **deciduous** __**__forests__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most common types of forests in** India are tropical deciduous forests. **They are also known as monsoon woods, and they cover a region that receives between 200 and 70 cm of precipitation annually.
 
• The **northernmost deciduous forest** in North America can be found in Sonora, Mexico.
 
• This environment, which is sometimes referred to as a tropical savanna, **historically extended continuously** from northern Mexico over a thousand miles into Central America, but only **15% of it is now there, and only 1% of it is protected.**
 
• **Mysore, a city in Karnataka, **is referred to as India's** "Sandalwood City."** Sandalwood is made from trees in the genus Santalum.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **North-Western region **of the country, which includes the semi-arid states of Gujarat, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Haryana, and Madhya Pradesh, is home to **tropical thorn forests and scrubs,** where the annual rainfall is less than 70 cm.
 
• **Mangroves, a group of trees and shrubs**, are found in the intertidal zone along the shore. Mangrove forest in Florida's Loxahatchee. Mangrove trees come in roughly **80 different species.**
 
• The dense, **multi-layered tropical evergreen forests** are home to a wide variety of plants and animals. These woods are located in regions with a lot of rainfall (more than 200 cm annual rainfall). **They have great density.**
